purpose: Freeze the first independent semantic judge identity, prompt contract, provider transport, batching, output mode, cost guard, and operational-failure semantics before observing any labels from that judge.

judge.selection_reason: Independent Qwen-family judge available through the already-used Groq path; synthetic reliability gate remains mandatory before any real DEV semantic packet may be read.

prompt_contract.output_shape: JSON object with exactly one results array; each item contains case_id, claim_type, support_label only; no rationale
support_policy: SUPPORTED only when the visible case or explicit public-contract fact directly supports the factual claim
CONTRADICTED when visible evidence directly conflicts with the factual claim
NOT_SUPPORTED when a factual claim is neither directly supported nor directly contradicted
NOT_APPLICABLE for conditional/hypothetical, procedural recommendation, uncertainty/epistemic, or non-world-metadata units where factual support is not the applicable judgment
generic domain plausibility is not support
tool availability does not imply a tool result was observed
do not convert conditional/future language into a current fact

post_result_rules.if_reliability_fails: Do not run this judge on the real DEV packet and do not repair its prompt using real candidate labels.
post_result_rules.if_operational_failure: Do not interpret as reliability evidence. A future operational replacement requires an explicit preregistered amendment before any real semantic measurement.
post_result_rules.if_reliability_passes: Judge may be used on the already-built E14n DEV semantic packet under the frozen v4.2 protocol; VALIDATION remains unauthorized.
